canonical_statement: For every univariate polynomial f with complex coefficients, if f is not a constant polynomial, then there exists a complex number z such that f evaluates to zero at z.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression: forall f : @Polynomial.{0} Complex Complex.instSemiring, Stage1Instances.THM_M_0012.Nonconstant f -> exists z, @Polynomial.IsRoot.{0} Complex Complex.instSemiring f z

domain_and_universes: f : Polynomial Complex; z : Complex; concrete carriers in universe 0; target Prop in universe 0; no typeclass binders or additional premises.
hypotheses: Stage1Instances.THM_M_0012.Nonconstant f, defined as the negation of existence of c : Complex with f = Polynomial.C c
conclusion: There exists z : Complex with Polynomial.IsRoot f z, definitionally equivalent to Polynomial.eval z f = 0.
